principles: Host-neutral workflow commands stay outside adapter namespaces.
Read-only audit first; mutations require later evidence and explicit gates.
Lineage metadata must be versioned so future canonicalization changes remain auditable.
Derived learning artifacts must not masquerade as independent gate evidence.
Fix real correctness/observability gaps without speculative optimization.
drivers: User needs to know whether historical experience is actually consumable by playbook promotion without duplicate source counting.
Current Lattice gates do not audit learning source lineage or dedup priority.
The safest first increment is a read-only command that proves scope before seed creation or auto-promotion.

options.name: Read-only generic source_lineage_audit M1
pros: Proves duplicate and missing lineage issues without changing runtime behavior
Keeps command host-neutral and reusable beyond Proofbound learning
Gives later seed/promotion stories a stable evidence surface
cons: Does not itself generate candidates or activate playbooks
Requires later stories for seed observe and runtime consumer closure

options.name: Playbook-specific seed promotion implementation now
pros: Could move historical experience toward candidates faster
Directly targets the visible playbook backlog question
cons: Risks double-counting sources before lineage is understood
Mixes read-only diagnosis with mutating proposal creation and promotion policy

options.name: Do nothing until auto-promotion design is complete
cons: Leaves duplicate lineage blind spot in place
Keeps historical experience disconnected from auditable promotion evidence

rationale: Choose the read-only generic audit because it addresses the real blind spot first, preserves Proofbound evidence boundaries, and creates a reusable host-neutral foundation for later seed proposal and promotion work.

preMortem.trigger: Collector reuses mutating store helpers or initializes files eagerly
preMortem.consequence: A read-only diagnostic changes project evidence state
preMortem.mitigation: Use read-only readers, test empty-store posture, and classify command readOnly/L0

preMortem.trigger: Normalization rules change but records do not carry version/hash
preMortem.consequence: Old lineage cannot be interpreted or compared reliably
preMortem.mitigation: Emit canonicalSourceKeyVersion and canonicalizationPolicyHash for every record

preMortem.scenario: Derived artifacts look like gate evidence
preMortem.consequence: Learning diagnostics could be mistaken for lifecycle proof
preMortem.mitigation: Set authority=non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false and smoke-test that boundary
